title: Sign bit and byte order of int.from_bytes
summary: The byte string 80 00 is interpreted as 32768 in big-endian unsigned format, and -32768 in big-endian signed format.
applies: Python 3; standard library or built-in integers
detail: signed=True uses two's complement; when the same string is interpreted according to little endian, the most significant byte becomes 00, and the result is a positive number 128.
boundary: signed and byteorder are two independent parameters; reversing bytes is not equivalent to changing the sign.
relevance: Avoid mistaking endianness errors for overflows when reading negative displacement or sensor data.
